metadata.description: Simple Drawing Pad: sketch an idea by hand with a graphics tablet, mouse or touch screen and let Claude look at it (drawing window on Windows, a browser board elsewhere).

plugins.name: simple-drawing-pad
plugins.description: Like dictation, but drawn - a quick sketch takes your idea to Claude or any app. Ctrl+Alt+D = draw · Enter = copy · Ctrl+V = paste. Simple as that. A small helper is built on your PC from the included source (nothing downloaded, no admin rights). Local only, no network, collects nothing. Starts with Windows (a shortcut in your Startup folder). It asks once per computer before installing, and a short local check at each session start tells Claude if it works. Remove it with /simple-drawing-pad:uninstall. For Windows PCs only.
